title: Generic 'curio' trinket items silently changed name/description with no player action. 'a small worn ring' (found in Sunken Howe, Fenmarch) became 'a bog-glass bead necklace'; 'a cracked spyglass' (Flood-Watch tower) became 'a sergeant's brass whistle'; 'a hand-drawn charm against the gray' (given by Yarrow) became 'a woven eel-trap charm'; 'a broken hunting knife' (Eel-Run den) became 'a coil of tarred eel-line'. The swap happened somewhere between leaving Thornwold and arriving in the Iron Downs, confirmed stable across two consecutive status checks afterward. Contradicts state: the same carried objects should keep their identity.
